friction: Kid Home is the parent dashboard: about 6 boxes and 30-45 words before the first button; the only 'what to do next' card is the LAST block
suggested_fix: In kid mode put one huge 'Keep going' button with icon at the top; hide streak, level and stats boxes

friction: No read-aloud for a pre-reader; speechSynthesis exists only inside one phonics block
suggested_fix: Add a speaker button on the Home CTA, question prompt and result headline using the existing speak()

friction: Kid tabs are text-only 13px pills (icons hidden below 1024px); 'Starting quiz / Quizzes / Lessons' mean nothing to a 6-year-old
suggested_fix: Show icons at every width in kid mode and make tab labels bigger

friction: Next-lesson button calls go('live'), which is not a kid tab, so the tap silently returns to Home
suggested_fix: Hide or replace that tap target in kid mode

friction: Error reads "The server didn't respond within 15s (http://localhost:4000). Is the API running?" in a red box; only 'Try again' is usable
suggested_fix: In kid mode show 'Oops!' with one big Retry button and hide the technical text

friction: No right/wrong reaction while answering, so no instant praise; correctness only shows at the end (Warm-up has it)
suggested_fix: Add a friendly per-question reaction (tick / 'try again') or at least a 'Saved!' animation

friction: A miss is explained in percentages: 'You scored 40%, 25 points short of the 70% pass mark...' about 25 words
suggested_fix: Kid variant: stars, one line ('Nearly there!') and one big 'Try again' button; numbers under a grown-up fold

friction: Hand-in takes 3 screens of reading: Review answers, 'Ready to hand in?', 'You still have N unanswered' popup
suggested_fix: For kids go from the last question to one 'All done!' button

friction: 'Take the quiz' sits below small-print instructions, far from the title
suggested_fix: Put the main action directly under the title in kid mode

friction: Retake copy is a sentence: 'One attempt only. Ask your tutor if you need another go.' / 'You can retake this in 2h'
suggested_fix: Big icon plus 'Ask a grown-up' instead of a sentence

friction: Rating uses 'Again / Hard / Good / Easy' and keyboard hints; a 6-year-old can't self-grade
suggested_fix: Kid mode: 3 faces (try again / nearly / got it) and spoken card text

friction: No 'what next' after a quiz/homework; only 'Back to quizzes' / 'Retake'. The all-done card appears on Home only when every quiz is done
suggested_fix: Reuse Home's `step` to show one big 'Next: Flashcards' button on every end screen

friction: goToTab clicks hidden buttons by regex; failure text is 'Open the Flashcards tab at the top of this page.'
suggested_fix: Use the shell's go('flashcards'); no reading-only fallback

friction: Progress is 11.5px grey text ('Question 3 of 10 · 2 answered') and small number chips
suggested_fix: Show a big bar or stars filling instead

friction: Typed or written answers need reading and typing ('Write your answer here. Your tutor will read and mark it.')
suggested_fix: Kid mode: photo or voice answer; or skip written questions for pre-readers
